description: Python source code for a real-time event plotting widget in the BORIS behavioral observation software, including class definition for Plot_events_RT with methods for event aggregation and plotting.

classes.name: Plot_events_RT
classes.description: A QWidget subclass for real-time plotting of behavioral events with interactive controls.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Plot_events_RT widget, sets up UI components and internal state.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Intercepts key press events and forwards them to the main window.

methods.name: change_mode
methods.description: Toggles between plotting behaviors only or behaviors with modifiers.

methods.name: time_interval_changed
methods.description: Adjusts the time window for event visualization.

methods.name: aggregate_events
methods.description: Aggregates events into intervals considering subject, code, and modifiers.

methods.name: plot_events
methods.description: Plots the aggregated events centered around the current time.
